name: Kashidashi Hire
description: Kashidashi Hire is an austere, documentary-styled WordPress theme built for construction plant hire yards and equipment rental depots. Engineered with a disciplined sans-serif typographic system, bespoke diagonal framing accents and tabbed fleet directories, it presents weekly machine availability with quiet operational clarity. The responsive layout provides structured equipment listings, straightforward hire schedules and seamless date inquiry workflows.
